subject: science
notes: Sinharaja Forest Reserve in southwestern Sri Lanka is the country's last large area of undisturbed tropical rainforest.
More than 60 percent of its tree species are found nowhere else in the world.
Many of the forest's birds feed in mixed-species flocks, groups in which several bird species move through the forest together.
Ornithologist Nalaka Wijesinghe wanted to know whether the flocks follow one particular species when they move.
His team followed flocks on foot and recorded which species was the first to move each time a flock changed position.
The team found that the flocks usually moved after a bird called the orange-billed babbler moved.
stem: The student wants to present the aim and method of Wijesinghe's study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Wijesinghe's team followed bird flocks on foot through Sinharaja, a forest where more than 60 percent of the tree species are found nowhere else.
choices.B: To find out whether Sinharaja's mixed-species flocks follow one particular species, Wijesinghe's team followed flocks on foot and recorded which species moved first.
choices.C: Wijesinghe's team found that the mixed-species flocks of Sinharaja usually moved after a bird called the orange-billed babbler moved.
choices.D: Sinharaja Forest Reserve, in southwestern Sri Lanka, is the country's last large area of undisturbed tropical rainforest.

explanation.why: The goal has two parts: the aim (what Wijesinghe wanted to find out) and the method (what the team did). The aim was to learn whether flocks follow one species; the method was following flocks on foot and recording which species moved first. Only one choice contains both.
explanation.A: Incorrect. It gives the method and adds a fact about the trees, but it never says what the team wanted to learn. It covers only half the goal.
explanation.B: Correct. "To find out whether … flocks follow one particular species" is the aim, and following flocks and recording the first mover is the method.
explanation.C: Incorrect. It reports the study's finding, not its aim or its method.
explanation.D: Incorrect. It is background about the forest and says nothing about the study.
